cues.text: Before we start, Jimmy and Kathy, thanks for coming in today to talk about your current research paper!
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Well, I will also give you some suggestions for your future presentation later.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: That’s great!
cues.speaker: Jimmy

cues.text: Okay, I have read the introductory chapter, and so far I like where you’re going with your research, you two.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Thanks! What did you think of the procedure section?
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: I haven’t gotten there yet. I will get to that and the results and discussion section in a bit.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Oh. If you haven’t read the rest, are you just saying you like the introduction?
cues.speaker: Jimmy

cues.text: No - the layout is really well done. You have each section clearly marked and have the header and footer perfectly formatted, and your title page is right on the money.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: A lot of students have trouble with that one.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: To be honest, we did refer a lot to the example we received in class.
cues.speaker: Jimmy

cues.text: That’s good to do for spacing and layout, as long as you’re not also copying the information.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: The background information is a little spare, though. You may want to add it.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: You think so? I was more worried about whether I had enough data.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: You definitely need more background information. I would think about finding some more online articles or doing more research in the campus library.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: That’s a good idea - we can go tomorrow. I find it too tough finding the subject matter in the online journal database.
cues.speaker: Jimmy

cues.text: I also like being able to flip through the physical journal as opposed to trying to scroll down on a computer.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Me too. Oh, I almost forgot. I’ve included all of my citations in the abstract, but could you help me with the bibliography?
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: I should be using a bibliography, right? Not an appendix?
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: Sure, I can help with that. Yes - for this type of scientific research paper, list all sources that you cite in the body of your paper in a bibliography.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Go to the website I gave you last time to see the exact way to list each source.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Okay, thanks. I’ll do that. We still have a lot of things to fix up.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: Yeah, but there’s a lot of good stuff here to work with. So enough about the paper, how is the presentation going?
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Well, it’s alright. I am going to go try out the new presentation software while Jimmy’s working on the bibliography.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: Yeah, we are going to make an animation of an actual pump but still have a lot to learn about how to do that.
cues.speaker: Jimmy

cues.text: Who would have thought before we started this project that we would be able to recreate the motion of a pump? This stuff is just so interesting.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: So glad to hear it!
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Yeah, I am glad I took engineering this semester. I would definitely like to keep up with it.
cues.speaker: Jimmy

cues.text: You know, there’s an organization called the Machine Engineering Society. You should look into joining it.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: You would need to score well in your engineering class to qualify, but I think you can do it.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Hm, interesting. I will definitely check it out.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: I would really like to get in contact with some professionals in the engineering field to find out more.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: I don’t really know anyone in the field now, though.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: I think if you keep meeting people in your classes and professors you’ll be able to get in contact with some really helpful people.
cues.speaker: Jimmy

cues.text: Well said, Jimmy. If engineering pumps is something you both are specifically interested in, make sure you stay up to date on new developments.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: In fact, you could visit the local water treatment facility periodically to see what new developments are going on.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Hm, that may be a good way to get some practical experience.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: Well, I don’t think they would let you handle any equipment by just visiting the facility.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: If you really want to get your hands dirty, so to speak, I would recommend instead seeking a summer internship.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Wow, you have so many helpful suggestions for getting a leg up.
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: Now if only you could tell me how to get my work published!
cues.speaker: Kathy

cues.text: Haha, wouldn’t that be nice.
cues.speaker: Jimmy

cues.text: Well, honestly, all you really need to do is once you have a dissertation, present it.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Present it often and to many audiences, and once you get feedback, adjust it. I’ll get published one day.
cues.speaker: Tutor

cues.text: Wow, this meeting has been truly inspiring. Thanks for your help!
cues.speaker: Kathy
